# data/processed/

This directory holds all **generated** data files. All CSV files here are gitignored and must be regenerated by running the pipeline scripts in order.

## Files generated by the pipeline

| File | Generated by | Rows | Description |
|------|-------------|------|-------------|
| `combined_verified.csv` | `02_harmonize_verify.R` | 737,799 | Harmonized combined dataset (2014 + 2022), verified PASS |
| `train_2014.csv` | `03_split_data.R` | ~345,502 | 80% stratified split of 2014 data |
| `test_2014.csv`  | `03_split_data.R` | ~86,375  | 20% stratified split of 2014 data |
| `train_2022.csv` | `03_split_data.R` | ~244,738 | 80% stratified split of 2022 data |
| `test_2022.csv`  | `03_split_data.R` | ~61,184  | 20% stratified split of 2022 data |
| `train_combined.csv` | `03_split_data.R` | ~590,239 | 80% stratified split of combined data |
| `test_combined.csv`  | `03_split_data.R` | ~147,560 | 20% stratified split of combined data |

## How to regenerate

Run from the repo root (in order):

```r
source("scripts/00_setup.R")
source("scripts/02_harmonize_verify.R")  # produces combined_verified.csv
source("scripts/03_split_data.R")        # produces all 6 train/test CSVs
```

> Requires raw files in `data/raw/` first. See `data/raw/README.md`.

## Schema — combined_verified.csv (34 columns)

All splits inherit this schema (minus `Year` for individual-year splits).

### Raw integer features (used for modeling)
| Column | Description | Range |
|--------|-------------|-------|
| `Diabetes_Binary` | Target: 0=No Diabetes, 1=Diabetes/Prediabetes | 0, 1 |
| `X_AGE_G` | Age group | 1–6 |
| `X_EDUCAG` | Education level | 1–4 |
| `X_INCOMG` | Income tier (harmonized to 5 levels) | 1–5 |
| `X_RACEGR` | Race group (harmonized from X_RACEGR3/X_RACEGR4) | 1–5 |
| `GENHLTH` | General health (1=Excellent–5=Poor) | 1–5 |
| `PHYSHLTH` | Poor physical health days (past 30) | 1–30 |
| `MENTHLTH` | Poor mental health days (past 30) | 1–30 |
| `DIFFWALK` | Difficulty walking (1=Yes, 2=No) | 1–2 |
| `X_BMI5` | BMI × 100 (raw code) | ~1200–9964 |
| `X_BMI5CAT` | BMI category (1=Underweight–4=Obese) | 1–4 |
| `CVDCRHD4` | Coronary heart disease (1=Yes, 2=No) | 1–2 |
| `CVDSTRK3` | Stroke (1=Yes, 2=No) | 1–2 |
| `X_SMOKER3` | Smoking status (1=Daily–4=Never) | 1–4 |
| `X_TOTINDA` | Physical activity (1=Active, 2=Inactive) | 1–2 |
| `DRNKANY` | Any alcohol past 30 days (1=Yes, 2=No) | 1–2 |
| `SLEPTIM1` | Sleep hours per night | 1–24 |
| `INSULIN` | Currently uses insulin (1=Yes, 2=No) | 1–2 |
| `HLTHPLN` | Has health coverage (1=Yes, 2=No) | 1–2 |
| `MEDCOST` | Couldn't see doctor due to cost (1=Yes, 2=No) | 1–2 |

### Derived character labels (for EDA and visualization)
| Column | Levels |
|--------|--------|
| `Diabetes_Label` | "No Diabetes", "Diabetes/Prediabetes" |
| `BMI` | Numeric (X_BMI5 ÷ 100) |
| `Age_Group` | 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65+ |
| `Education` | No HS, HS Grad, Some College, College Grad |
| `Income` | <15k, 15-25k, 25-35k, 35-50k, >50k |
| `Race` | White, Black, Hispanic, Multiracial, Other |
| `BMI_Category` | Underweight, Normal, Overweight, Obese |
| `Gen_Health` | Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair, Poor |
| `Physical_Activity` | Active, Inactive |
| `Smoker` | Never, Former, Occasional, Daily |
| `Heart_Disease` | Yes, No |
| `Stroke` | Yes, No |
| `Insulin` | Yes, No |
| `Year` | 2014, 2022 (combined only) |
